messages.content: You are a helpful research assistant. Use the provided source materials to answer the user's research question. Give a clear, informative answer and cite the source(s) you draw on.

Research question:
Research and analyze the latest advancements and cutting-edge theories within the field of game design. Specifically include recent developments, research, and practical design applications related to established frameworks like MDA (Mechanics-Dynamics-Aesthetics).

Provided sources:

[Source A]
Source: Hunicke, LeBlanc, Zubek, "MDA: A Formal Approach to Game Design and Game Research",
AAAI Workshop (Game Developers Conference), 2004 — retrieved 2026-09-13
URL: https://aaai.org/papers/ws04-04-001-mda-a-formal-approach-to-game-design-and-game-research/

"MDA is a formal approach to understanding games — one which attempts to bridge the gap between game
design and development, game criticism, and technical game research."

Source: Wikipedia, "MDA framework" — retrieved 2026-09-13 — CC BY-SA
